$comment: Machine-checkable gates for the eleven presets in references/theme-presets.md.
Read by scripts/verify-preset.mjs. Every value here is transcribed from that
file — accent hexes and radii from each preset's token block, separation and
density from the 'Choosing between them' table, traps from each preset's own
stated trap paragraph. If a preset changes there, change it here.
DELIBERATELY NOT GATED: density and 'does it feel like the direction'.
Density is declared for reporting only — it is a composition judgement, and a
gate on it would give false confidence. See the limits section in the runner.

universal.$comment: From the five disciplines + the ship checklist. Apply to every preset.

universalTrap.rule: White text on an accent FILL is forbidden in every preset — theme-presets.md states it once for all of them.
universalTrap.check: no element may render #ffffff text on a background equal to the preset accent

traps.rule: Never ship the pale-card + white-text pairing.

B.name: Blueprint Mono
B.accentNote: This direction has NO accent. The gate inverts: assert no accent-like fill is doing the work of one.

traps.rule: White text on --accent measures 2.07:1. The accent is FILL ONLY.
--muted is a material tone at 3.35:1 — decorative only, never body copy.

E.name: Terracotta Commerce
E.separationNote: One of only two shadow presets. theme-presets.md: do not mix shadow and hairline strategies inside one application.

traps.rule: On this dark ground the accent IS a text colour (9.11:1), but its FILL still needs dark ink — white on amber is 2.13:1.
The ghost wordmark sits at 1.14:1. It is decorative texture and must never overlap body copy.
traps.mustNotOverlap: h1, h2, p, li, dd, dt, a, button

H.name: Studio Kinetic
H.separationNote: Second shadow preset — tilted cards need a cast shadow to sit above the grid.
